items.name: theme
items.title: Kitsaas Theme
items.description: Kitsaas --v2-* design tokens (light and dark schemes) and Tailwind v4 @theme bindings.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Opens one section at a time unless multiple is set; every trigger stays in the tab order, disabled ones included.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: An inline callout for a status or warning that stays on the page, in neutral, info, success, warning and danger, with optional title, icon and action.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Asks for explicit confirmation before a critical or destructive action, supporting async confirm handlers and imperative confirm flows.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Keeps its content at a fixed width-to-height ratio with native CSS aspect-ratio; images and video inside fill and cover the box.

items.name: autocomplete
items.title: Autocomplete
items.description: Suggests matching options while you type without restricting free-form input, with inline completion, highlighting, and live status updates.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Shows initials until the image loads and keeps them if it fails, reporting the loading status on every part.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small inline label for metadata and status chips, ported from opencode: compact or standard, in neutral, accent, subtle and danger, plus info, success and warning.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Stays pending while an async action runs, handles disabled state, and renders as a link when given an href.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Joins related buttons, inputs, and menus into one segmented control, with separators and nested groups.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Picks a single date, multiple dates, or a continuous date range from a keyboard-navigable month grid.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: opencode console's dashboard card with shadcn parts: header with title, description and action, content, footer, plus the console's inset tile and label/value facts. A link in the title makes the whole card clickable.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Pages through slides using native scroll snap, arrow controls, progress tracking, and pagination indicators.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Reports checked, unchecked and mixed through ARIA, and keeps a hidden native input in sync, so it submits and resets with its form.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Shows and hides one panel; the trigger stays focusable and keeps its contents only while it is open.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: Selects colors across a 2D area, hue and alpha sliders, CSS/channel inputs, swatches, and an optional eyedropper.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Searches a list of options to choose one or several values, with selection chips, groups, select-all, and creatable entries.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Fuzzy-searches actions and grouped commands with keyboard shortcut hints and nested sub-views, inline or inside a dialog.

items.name: date-input
items.title: Date Input
items.description: Edits dates and date-times one locale-ordered segment at a time with arrow-key stepping and native form submission.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: Combines a segmented date field with a floating calendar popover for single dates, ranges, and quick presets.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Opens a task in the top layer, traps focus, closes on Escape, a press outside or a close part, and returns focus to its trigger.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Slides a draggable sheet in from any screen edge with snap points, a resize handle, and nested stacking.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: A centred empty state for a list or panel: icon, title, description and actions.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Ties a control to its label and description, and marks every part invalid once a submit finds a problem.

items.name: file-input
items.title: File Input
items.description: Accepts dropped, pasted, or browsed files with validation, file list management, and form submission.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: Previews a link on hover or keyboard focus, stays open while the pointer crosses the gap, and still follows the link on press.

items.name: image-cropper
items.title: Image Cropper
items.description: Crops images by resizing a selection box or panning and zooming behind a fixed frame, with aspect-ratio, rotate, and flip controls.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Reports typing, clearing and a form reset with their reasons, and clears from a group part that returns focus to the field.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A row with media, a title, a description and actions, like the console's settings and billing lists. ItemGroup can rove focus across link rows with the arrow keys.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A key cap for keyboard shortcuts, ported from opencode: neutral, ghost or outline, grouped into combinations, with ⌘ on Mac and Ctrl elsewhere from a single shortcut string.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Names native inputs and custom controls alike, forwarding clicks to activate or focus the associated control.

items.name: listbox
items.title: Listbox
items.description: Presents an always-visible option list with roving focus, typeahead, groups, and single or multi-range selection.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Opens a list of actions with the arrow keys, typeahead and Escape, keeping checked items in place and a submenu open under the pointer.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: Connects top-level application menus under a single tab stop so arrow keys and hover glide seamlessly between them.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: Displays a bounded measurement such as storage or quota, classifying optimum, suboptimum, and critical ranges semantically.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Groups site navigation links into floating disclosure panels with keyboard support and a sliding active indicator.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: Formats locale-aware numbers, currencies, and units with stepper buttons, keyboard stepping, and scrubbable labels.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: Collects one-time verification codes across individual slots with paste handling, autofill, and native form validation.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Navigates multi-page datasets with ellipsis collapsing, first/previous/next/last controls, and router-friendly links.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: Enters secrets with an integrated visibility toggle button and full Field validation support.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Opens a small task beside its trigger, moves focus in, flips and shifts to stay in view, and returns focus on close.

items.name: preferences
items.title: Preferences
items.description: Applies storage-backed user preferences onto data attributes so CSS can adapt before hydration without flash.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Reports how far a task has come through the progressbar role, and sweeps while the value is unknown.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: Keeps one value across the group, checks as the arrow keys move, and submits the checked option with its form.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: Picks whole or half-star ratings with hover preview, arrow-key navigation, and read-only average displays.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Splits layouts into draggable, keyboard-resizable, and collapsible panels horizontally, vertically, or nested.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: Pairs native scrolling with styled thin scrollbars, edge overflow fades, and stick-to-end streaming behavior.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: Keeps one option checked with a single tab stop, moves the selection with the arrow keys, and slides its indicator to the checked item.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Opens a listbox under the trigger, moves the highlight with the arrow keys and typeahead, and keeps the chosen value — or values, with multiple — in the form.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Divides content with a horizontal or vertical hairline, announced to screen readers unless it is decorative.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Composable application sidebar built on @ui-sdk/core with collapsible offcanvas and icon modes, floating and inset variants, groups, submenus, rail toggle, and mobile drawer support.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: opencode console's loading placeholder: a faint bar with a slow shimmer, faded in after 120ms. Decorative by default; reduced motion drops the sweep.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Adjusts single values or multi-thumb ranges with pointer dragging, stepped marks, and keyboard controls.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: opencode's Loader ring, the one the console shows while loading: 16px, a third of the ring turning every 900ms, with role=status and a Loading label.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Turns a setting on and off in place, keeps a hidden native input in sync, and submits and resets with its form.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: opencode console's data tables on native table elements with shadcn parts: the members table (header pill, row hover) or the framed data table. Numeric columns, footer totals, caption, selected rows and aria-sort headers.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switches panels with one tab selected at a time, moving focus and selection with the arrow keys and tying each tab to its panel.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Reports typing, a form reset and a controller's changes with their reasons, and grows with its text when autoResize is set.

items.name: time-input
items.title: Time Input
items.description: Edits 12-hour or 24-hour times segment by segment with optional seconds and min/max validation.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Presents chronological events, changelogs, or workflow milestones with connectors, status markers, and arrow-key navigation.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Stacks notifications in a live region, pauses its timer while hovered or focused, and closes on Escape, a swipe or its own duration.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Keeps a button pressed or coordinates single and multi-select toggle groups with arrow-key navigation.

items.name: token-input
items.title: Token Input
items.description: Mixes free text with removable inline tokens for tags, recipients, or references with keyboard selection and deletion.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: Groups buttons, toggles, inputs, menus, and separators under a single roving tab stop.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Names or describes its trigger on hover and keyboard focus, flips to another side when there is no room, and closes on Escape without moving focus.

items.name: tree
items.title: Tree
items.description: Navigates nested file hierarchies and expandable branches with arrow keys, typeahead, and single or tri-state selection.

items.name: trigger-menu
items.title: Trigger Menu
items.description: Opens caret-anchored suggestions when typing trigger characters like @, /, or # inside an input or textarea.

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: opencode console's prose with shadcn's Typography parts: headings, paragraph, lead, large, small, muted, blockquote, list and inline code, plus a container that spaces them or rendered markdown, in default or compact size.

items.name: waterfall
items.title: Waterfall
items.description: Visualizes request traces and nested spans along a shared millisecond time axis with expandable rows and milestones.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Opencode-styled data visualization primitives built on @tanstack/charts.
